data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: ChinaTextbook
ui_devex.summary: ChinaTextbook是一个开源项目，汇集了中国小学、初中、高中及大学阶段的PDF教材，旨在为教育工作者和学生提供免费、便捷的学习资源。该项目按学段和学科系统化整理教材，便于用户快速查找所需内容，体现了开放教育资源的实用价值。用户可直接下载教材用于课堂教学、自主学习或研究参考，也可基于此构建个性化学习工具，促进教育资源的共享与创新应用。
ui_devex.summary_en: ChinaTextbook is a comprehensive open-source repository that provides free access to PDF textbooks covering primary, secondary, and university education levels in China, addressing the need for accessible educational materials. The project organizes content systematically by educational stages and subjects, making it easy to navigate and locate specific resources. Educators and students can use these materials for teaching, self-study, or as references to supplement formal curricula, while developers might explore integrating them into educational apps or platforms.

ui_devex.name: celld
ui_devex.summary: celld 是 Deno 团队开源的分布式 Durable Objects 运行时，让开发者能自托管 Cloudflare 风格的有状态无服务器应用。它用 Rust 编写，核心思路是把“状态+逻辑”封装成一个可寻址对象，由某个节点唯一持有并处理请求；节点故障时自动迁移，从而在分布环境下简化一致性问题。这种设计兼顾强一致与低延迟，尤其适合状态密集、需要协同的场景。你可以使用 celld 自建多人游戏后端、实时协作编辑器或物联网控制平台，既保留数据主权，又获得类似云厂商的 Durable Objects 体验。
ui_devex.summary_en: celld is a self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects runtime that brings Cloudflare-style stateful serverless compute to your own infrastructure. Built in Rust, it provides a lightweight coordination, replication, and storage layer, so you can build strongly consistent, location-aware services without managing complex distributed systems. Its core design treats each unit of state and logic as a movable, addressable object owned by a single node at a time, with automatic failover. That simplifies consistency and enables low-latency access. You can use celld for multiplayer backends, collaborative editing, or IoT coordination on hardware you control.

ui_devex.name: authentik
ui_devex.summary: authentik 是一款开源身份提供商，集中管理各应用的身份验证与授权，消除分散的登录系统和混乱的访问策略。其技术核心在于灵活可配置的登录、注册及多因素认证流程，支持 OIDC/OAuth2 协议，并原生集成 Kubernetes。用户可通过 Docker 或 Helm 部署，借助代理或 SSO 端点连接现有应用，定制实际访问控制流程。
ui_devex.summary_en: authentik is an open-source identity provider that centralizes authentication and authorization across your applications, eliminating scattered login systems and inconsistent access policies. Its key technical strength lies in flexible, configurable flows for login, registration, and MFA, paired with OIDC/OAuth2 support and native Kubernetes integration. You can deploy it via Docker or Helm, connect existing apps through its proxy or SSO endpoints, and customize flows for real-world access control.

agents_workflows.name: TradingAgents
agents_workflows.summary: TradingAgents是一个开源的多智能体金融交易框架，通过协调多个AI代理实现自动化市场分析和交易决策，解决了单一模型处理复杂金融数据的局限性。其核心技术在于利用大语言模型解析市场信息，让不同专业代理分工协作，形成更稳健的交易策略。用户可基于该框架定制交易逻辑，使用历史数据进行策略回测，并部署到实际交易环境中进行实验，适合开发者构建和测试自动化交易系统，探索AI在金融领域的应用潜力。
agents_workflows.summary_en: TradingAgents is an open-source framework that enables automated financial trading by coordinating multiple AI agents, addressing the complexity of real-time market analysis. Its technical innovation lies in using large language models to interpret market signals and execute coordinated strategies across specialized agents. Developers can implement custom trading logic, backtest strategies with historical data, and deploy the system for algorithmic trading experiments, making it practical for both research and prototyping automated trading systems.

deployment_serving.name: authentik
deployment_serving.summary: authentik 是一款开源身份提供商，集中管理各应用的身份验证与授权，消除分散的登录系统和混乱的访问策略。其技术核心在于灵活可配置的登录、注册及多因素认证流程，支持 OIDC/OAuth2 协议，并原生集成 Kubernetes。用户可通过 Docker 或 Helm 部署，借助代理或 SSO 端点连接现有应用，定制实际访问控制流程。
deployment_serving.summary_en: authentik is an open-source identity provider that centralizes authentication and authorization across your applications, eliminating scattered login systems and inconsistent access policies. Its key technical strength lies in flexible, configurable flows for login, registration, and MFA, paired with OIDC/OAuth2 support and native Kubernetes integration. You can deploy it via Docker or Helm, connect existing apps through its proxy or SSO endpoints, and customize flows for real-world access control.

deployment_serving.name: celld
deployment_serving.summary: celld 是 Deno 团队开源的分布式 Durable Objects 运行时，让开发者能自托管 Cloudflare 风格的有状态无服务器应用。它用 Rust 编写，核心思路是把“状态+逻辑”封装成一个可寻址对象，由某个节点唯一持有并处理请求；节点故障时自动迁移，从而在分布环境下简化一致性问题。这种设计兼顾强一致与低延迟，尤其适合状态密集、需要协同的场景。你可以使用 celld 自建多人游戏后端、实时协作编辑器或物联网控制平台，既保留数据主权，又获得类似云厂商的 Durable Objects 体验。
deployment_serving.summary_en: celld is a self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects runtime that brings Cloudflare-style stateful serverless compute to your own infrastructure. Built in Rust, it provides a lightweight coordination, replication, and storage layer, so you can build strongly consistent, location-aware services without managing complex distributed systems. Its core design treats each unit of state and logic as a movable, addressable object owned by a single node at a time, with automatic failover. That simplifies consistency and enables low-latency access. You can use celld for multiplayer backends, collaborative editing, or IoT coordination on hardware you control.

framework_core.name: celld
framework_core.summary: celld 是 Deno 团队开源的分布式 Durable Objects 运行时，让开发者能自托管 Cloudflare 风格的有状态无服务器应用。它用 Rust 编写，核心思路是把“状态+逻辑”封装成一个可寻址对象，由某个节点唯一持有并处理请求；节点故障时自动迁移，从而在分布环境下简化一致性问题。这种设计兼顾强一致与低延迟，尤其适合状态密集、需要协同的场景。你可以使用 celld 自建多人游戏后端、实时协作编辑器或物联网控制平台，既保留数据主权，又获得类似云厂商的 Durable Objects 体验。
framework_core.summary_en: celld is a self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects runtime that brings Cloudflare-style stateful serverless compute to your own infrastructure. Built in Rust, it provides a lightweight coordination, replication, and storage layer, so you can build strongly consistent, location-aware services without managing complex distributed systems. Its core design treats each unit of state and logic as a movable, addressable object owned by a single node at a time, with automatic failover. That simplifies consistency and enables low-latency access. You can use celld for multiplayer backends, collaborative editing, or IoT coordination on hardware you control.

framework_core.name: ChinaTextbook
framework_core.summary: ChinaTextbook是一个开源项目，汇集了中国小学、初中、高中及大学阶段的PDF教材，旨在为教育工作者和学生提供免费、便捷的学习资源。该项目按学段和学科系统化整理教材，便于用户快速查找所需内容，体现了开放教育资源的实用价值。用户可直接下载教材用于课堂教学、自主学习或研究参考，也可基于此构建个性化学习工具，促进教育资源的共享与创新应用。
framework_core.summary_en: ChinaTextbook is a comprehensive open-source repository that provides free access to PDF textbooks covering primary, secondary, and university education levels in China, addressing the need for accessible educational materials. The project organizes content systematically by educational stages and subjects, making it easy to navigate and locate specific resources. Educators and students can use these materials for teaching, self-study, or as references to supplement formal curricula, while developers might explore integrating them into educational apps or platforms.
